title: The sealed door
goals: Reach the end of the passage.
starting_code: # Walk to the door, break the seal, and walk to the end.
hints: Use `move_right` to stand next to the door, then you can use your new spell!
Use `cast` and give it the spell as a string.
Cast the spell *zelim* with quotes, and then use `move_right` to reach the end of the passage.
intro: Look, a door sealed by a glowing rune! Now that you have a wand, stand beside it and cast *zelim* to break the seal.
outro: You cast your first spell! That was amazing. The castle road is so close now.
learned: Now you know how to cast a spell with your wand, and that *zelim* breaks a seal.
